items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: before Papa Suns thing died, he wasn't along playing with me. I used to go get him... I used to go get him and bring him home... That was all. He's cured.

ctx.x: Yeah, I play with Papa Suns thing. Yeah. I play with the band, with Papa Suns thing. Did you get who was in Suns thing then? Did we get that? Well he said most of them. He said all the fellas would work together. Some think of the job he's bad, he's bad, he's bad, he's bad. Yeah.
That's why you call it Papa Suns thing, you know?
And he wouldn't have the steady men, huh?
